basket.capital: initial equal quarters in independent selected sleeves; cash for no selection
basket.dates: require identical holdout dates else unavailable
basket.rebalancing: no transfers or rebalancing between sleeves; equity=sum of sleeve equity/4
basket.status: secondary descriptive fractional-capital model; no extra hypothesis gate; never a KRW account or mixed-currency realized P&L

protocol.benchmark: same-window costed full buy-and-hold with initial and terminal costs
protocol.cost_source: core/quant/validate.py COST_BP_PER_SIDE; model floors, not current broker fee quotations

execution_model.boundaries: each split starts in cash; initial fee charged; last row forces liquidation and does not initiate a new position
execution_model.fees: solve target post-fee portfolio weight exactly; buy value delta/(1+c*w), sell value delta/(1-c*w)
execution_model.fill_timing: signal from close t executes close t+lag; marked return earned only after that fill
execution_model.portfolio: fractional shares plus nonnegative cash, no shorting or leverage; caps are target weights at rebalance and may drift between rebalances
execution_model.price_limitation: adjusted/close-only proxies do not prove executable prices, partial fills, intraday stops, legal ownership, or affordable whole lots
execution_model.rebalance_anchor: first row of each evaluation split, then every k bars; binary signals are computed on every close
execution_model.sizing: min(cap,target_vol/trailing_annualized_vol) when target set; else cap; zero/invalid volatility gives cash

inference.cash_comparison: positive mean and zero-cash p are diagnostics; positive asset risk premium is not alpha
inference.hac: OLS strategy return on intercept and costed same-asset benchmark return, Bartlett Newey-West lag20, n/(n-2) correction; normal one-sided alpha p diagnostic only
inference.historical_contamination: all source caches were in prior research; formal p values are exploratory diagnostics, not fresh confirmatory evidence
inference.holdout_intervals: paired circular-block percentile95% mean, mean difference and Sharpe-difference intervals
inference.holdout_multiplicity: Holm across all8 frozen selected-versus-benchmark mean p values; unavailable/unselected assets assigned1
inference.monte_carlo_p: (1 + exceedance count)/(B+1); shared date draws across all candidates; no zero p values
inference.primary: centered circular moving-block maximum sqrt(T)*mean(strategy-minus-costed-benchmark), floored at0
inference.validation_multiplicity: Holm across all8 asset omnibus p values; unavailable assets assigned1

protocol.interpretation: Exploratory retrospective internal holdout, not untouched confirmation, live authorization, or investment advice.

prohibited_inferences: marked returns equal realized daily profit
end-of-day observations establish intraday floor compliance
missing inputs imply unlimited or zero allowance

promising_exploratory_criteria: positive holdout net mean at2x costs
provenance_rules: commit protocol, data manifest, candidate catalogue and source hashes before candidate P&L evaluation
publish all candidate outcomes and failed/insufficient cases
never retune after holdout or rerun search until a winner appears
retain previous frozen S_C3/GrokBot/H2 artifacts unchanged
any later change is a new study version with new trial accounting

signal_semantics.crossover: long when SMA_fast[t]/SMA_slow[t]-1 > band, otherwise cash
signal_semantics.donchian: enter above prior L closes max; exit below prior M closes min; current close excluded from thresholds; equality retains state
signal_semantics.drawdown: DD=P[t]/rolling_max_including_current-1; enter DD < -depth; exit DD > -depth*exit_fraction; equality retains state
signal_semantics.lowvol_trend: annualized trailing log-return sample SD <= quantile of252 prior vol estimates excluding current, and L-period price change >0
signal_semantics.rsi: simple rolling arithmetic mean of last L positive/negative price changes; enter RSI < lower, exit RSI > upper; equal retains; no losses gives100, both zero gives50
signal_semantics.sma: long when P[t]/mean(P[t-L+1:t+1])-1 > band, otherwise cash
signal_semantics.tsmom: long when P[t]/P[t-L]-1 > threshold, otherwise cash
signal_semantics.zscore: rolling log-price mean and sample SD include current close; enter z < -entry; exit z > -exit; equality retains state

purpose: retrospective exploratory internal holdout; no account, trading or live-validation path
